name: Milford Track
why: Four days up the Clinton valley, over Mackinnon Pass and down the Arthur valley past Sutherland Falls to Milford Sound.
book: Great Walk: Clinton, Mintaro and Dumpling huts must be booked months ahead for 1 Nov-30 Apr; no camping. One direction only. Book the bus to Te Anau Downs, the boat to Glade Wharf and the boat from Sandfly Point.
water: Tap water at the huts, untreated: boil it. Streams along the way, but do not fill bottles in the lakes (didymo).
dangers: Up to 9,000 mm of rain a year: the Clinton and Arthur valleys flood and DOC may close the track.
Avalanche risk on the pass approaches into December.
Day 3 climbs 500 m to the pass and drops 1,000 m to Dumpling Hut on rough, slippery ground.
Sandflies at every hut and stop.
turnaround: In cloud, snow or strong wind on Mackinnon Pass, follow the hut ranger's advice and wait a day at Mintaro rather than cross.

points.name: Glade Wharf
points.note: At the head of Lake Te Anau, after the 1 h 15 min boat from Te Anau Downs. Flat beech forest to Clinton Hut.

points.name: Clinton Hut
points.note: First night, 5 km from the wharf, with a wetland boardwalk.

points.name: Mintaro Hut
points.note: Second night by Lake Mintaro, at the foot of the pass after 17.5 km up the Clinton valley.

points.name: Mackinnon Pass
points.note: The McKinnon memorial and, just beyond, the shelter at 1,154 m, the highest point. Views of the Clinton Canyon.

points.name: Dumpling Hut
points.note: Third night. Leave packs at Quintin Shelter for the 1 h 30 min side trip to 580 m Sutherland Falls.

points.name: Sandfly Point
points.note: After 18 km along the Arthur River and Lake Ada. Be here for the early afternoon boat to Milford Sound.
